items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of 'uncle Bill' by the interviewee (Jones Hank). The mention appears in the Interviewer's turn ('I used to call him uncle Bill'), referring to the Interviewer's own father. The interviewee does not respond with personal knowledge or a relationship to this person.

ctx.x: When you found that out what did that make you think? Did you notice the coincidence at the time?

Just recently I noticed the coordination of the names, the Henry Williams and William Henry. I said, “I’ve never noticed that my father fell into that Henry Williams to." He said, "he is William Henry." I used to call him uncle Bill and he would say, "Well, good night pop." (Inaudible) that I was born in.
